name: Amaranthine Visage
descr:
**Price** 15,000 gp

**Usage** worn mask

**Bulk** L

**Access** You're from the Mordant Spire

---

The shape of this 2-foot-tall wooden mask, worn by the secretive leaders of the elves who inhabit the Mordant Spire, mirrors the tower itself. While wearing it, your innards turn to purple smoke, giving you [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) 10 to precision damage.

activations.name: Eternal Renewal
activations.text: **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** Your [dying](/condition/dying-player-core) condition would reach the value that would cause you to die; **Effect** You Sublimate Self. You lose the dying condition, gaining or increasing your [wounded](/condition/wounded-player-core) condition as normal, and gain [fast healing](/rule/fast-healing-and-regeneration-rules-2322) 20 for 1 minute. You can use Eternal Renewal even while [unconscious](/condition/unconscious-player-core) or otherwise unable to act.

activations.text: **Effect** Your body transforms completely into purple vapor for 5 minutes, with the effects of _[vapor form](/spell/vapor-form-player-core)_.
activations.effect: Your body transforms completely into purple vapor for 5 minutes, with the effects of _[vapor form](/spell/vapor-form-player-core)_.

name: Bloodstride Blade
descr:
_**PFS Note** This item is restricted due to the teleportation effect._

**Price** 3,000 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

**Base Weapon** [Sawtooth Saber](/item/sawtooth-saber-player-core)

**Access** You're a member of the Red Mantis Assassins

---

This _+2 [greater striking](/item/striking-gm-core) cunning [wounding](/item/wounding-gm-core) sawtooth saber_ appears rusty but never loses its edge. It’s drawn to the blood of your targets. You gain a +2 item bonus to [Seek](/action/seek-player-core) or [Track](/action/track-player-core) creatures that have blood.

activations.name: Call of the Bloodthirst
activations.text: ; **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** A creature within 60 feet takes [bleed](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core) damage; **Effect** You cast _[translocate](/spell/translocate-player-core)_, appearing adjacent to the triggering creature, then [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) it with this weapon. The creature is [off-guard](/condition/off-guard-player-core) to the attack.
activations.effect: You cast _[translocate](/spell/translocate-player-core)_, appearing adjacent to the triggering creature, then [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) it with this weapon. The creature is [off-guard](/condition/off-guard-player-core) to the attack.
activations.trigger: A creature within 60 feet takes [bleed](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core) damage

name: Bloodstride Boots
descr:
**Price** 2,400 gp

**Usage** worn shoes

**Bulk** L

**Access** You're a member of the Red Mantis Assassins

---

These red leather boots greedily absorb any blood they touch.

activations.name: Blood Hop
activations.text: **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** The boots produce a small pool of blood beneath your feet and in a free space you can see within 120 feet. You melt into the pool beneath you and reconstitute at the other pool, with the effects of _[translocate](/spell/translocate-player-core)_.

name: Cloak of Social Graces
descr:
**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L

**Access** You're from Hermea

---

These cloaks are created from hand-dyed leather decorated with gemstones, appealing to the individual tastes of the owner. The beautiful decorations of these cloaks encourage their owner to wear them no matter the season, making it visibly part of their unique style. Wearing the cloak boosts self-confidence, granting a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks.

## Cloak of Social Graces

**Price** 380 gp

## Greater Cloak of Social Graces

**Price** 3,000 gp

---

The item bonus is +2, and when you activate the cloak, you gain the benefits of a 6th-rank _heroism_ spell for 1 minute.

## Major Cloak of Social Graces

**Price** 40,000 gp

---

The item bonus is +3, and when you activate the cloak, you gain the benefits of a 9th-rank _heroism_ spell for 1 minute.

activations.name: Overcome Self-Doubt
activations.text: **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You readjust your cloak, straightening the collar and brushing out any wrinkles. You gain the effects of a _[heroism](/spell/heroism-player-core)_ spell for 1 minute.
activations.effect: You readjust your cloak, straightening the collar and brushing out any wrinkles. You gain the effects of a _[heroism](/spell/heroism-player-core)_ spell for 1 minute.

name: Coral Aspect
descr:
**Price** 80 gp

**Usage** worn mask

**Bulk** L

**Access** You're from the Mordant Spire

---

Made of petrified wood, this mask evokes the form of a coral reef. When you wear it, you gain a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to [Swim](/action/swim-player-core), and any armor you’re wearing gains the [aquadynamic](/trait/aquadynamic) trait.

activations.name: Cohabitate
activations.text: **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** For 1 minute, your body becomes a mobile coral reef, letting much smaller creatures pass through or shelter in it. Creatures at least one size category smaller than you can share your space. Allies that share your space gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC, and you gain [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) 5 to any damage caused by a creature sharing the same space as you.
activations.effect: For 1 minute, your body becomes a mobile coral reef, letting much smaller creatures pass through or shelter in it. Creatures at least one size category smaller than you can share your space. Allies that share your space gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC, and you gain [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) 5 to any damage caused by a creature sharing the same space as you.

name: Crown of the Master
descr:
**Usage** worn headwear

**Bulk** L

---

This crown, granted to favored azarketis by their alghollthu masters, is made of coral sculpted into the shape of a tentacled creature clutching the wearer’s temples. While wearing the crown, you gain an item bonus to saving throws against [mental](/trait/mental) effects and can cast _[figment](/spell/figment-player-core)_ as an occult [innate spell](/rule/innate-spells-rules-2232).

## Crown of the Master

**Price** 350 gp

---

The item bonus is +1.

## Greater Crown of the Master

**Price** 2,600 gp

---

The item bonus is +2, and the crown gains the following activation.

**Activate—Imperative Order** **Two Actions** ([concentrate](/trait/concentrate)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You cast a 6th-rank _[dominate](/spell/dominate-player-core)_ with a DC of 30. When you cast _dominate_ this way, its duration is reduced to 8 hours.

name: Gaze of the Mantis
descr:
_**PFS Note** Seeing all Red Mantis contracts is outside the scope of PFS play._

**Price** 1,400 gp

**Usage** worn eyepiece

**Bulk** L

**Access** You're a member of the Red Mantis Assassins

---

These glasses have faceted red lenses like those of a mantis and are popular as a less ostentatious alternative to a full mask. While wearing the _gaze of the mantis_, your field of view increases to give you better awareness of your surroundings. You gain a +2 item bonus to visual Perception checks and cannot be [flanked](/rule/flanking-rules-2375).

activations.name: Target Sense
activations.text: ; **Frequency** once per day; **Requirements** You’re a Red Mantis assassin; **Effect** You learn the distance to and direction of all creatures that have a Red Mantis contract on them within 10 miles. If one of these creatures is within 100 feet, you also know any afflictions, conditions, and spells affecting them. This awareness lasts for 1 hour.

name: Gloves of Precision
descr:
**Usage** worn gloves

**Access** You're from Hermea

---

These fingerless gloves increase the agility and sensitivity of the hands, enabling the wearer to perform more delicate, precise work. While wearing the _gloves of precision,_ you gain a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks to [Climb](/action/climb-player-core), and to Thievery checks to [Disable a Device](/action/disable-a-device-player-core) and [Pick a Lock](/action/pick-a-lock-player-core).

## Gloves of Precision

**Price** 900 gp

## Greater Gloves of Precision

**Price** 19,000 gp

---

The gloves grant a +3 item bonus.

name: Golden Wings
descr:
**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** 2

**Access** You're from Hermea

---

This pair of huge wings is crafted from numerous feathers made of a lightweight, golden magical alloy. When activated, the wings emit a melodic sound and a shimmering glow.

## Golden Wings

**Price** 60 gp

## Greater Golden Wings

**Price** 350 gp

---

When you activate the wings, for the duration, you can also use an action to flap the wings to glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 20 feet forward through the air. As long as you spend 1 action gliding each round and haven’t yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn.

## Major Golden Wings

**Price** 650 gp

---

When you activate the wings, you also gain a [fly Speed](/rule/fly-speed-rules-2350) of 20 feet for the duration.

## True Golden Wings

**Price** 14,000 gp

---

When you activate the wings, you also gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed or 25 feet, whichever is greater, for the duration.

activations.name: Assisted Flight
activations.text: **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** For the next 10 minutes, you can [Leap](/action/leap-player-core) 20 feet, using the wings to propel yourself. You must land on a space with solid ground. For the duration, you also emit a [bright light](/rule/bright-light-rules-2402) in a 20-foot radius and [dim light](/rule/dim-light-rules-2403) for the next 20 feet. You take a –2 item penalty to Stealth checks to [Hide](/action/hide-player-core) and [Sneak](/action/sneak-player-core).

**Access** You're from Hermea

**Price** 900 gp

**Price** 19,000 gp

The wraps grant a +3 item bonus.

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1

---

This _[+2 striking](/item/striking-gm-core) trident_ is made of golden metal, its handle carved with reliefs of waves and seashells. These tridents are often wielded by high-ranking azarketi soldiers in the ranks of alghollthu armies.

The swirls on this wooden mask—often worn by Mordant Censors—move and shift, reflecting the shape of the nearest currents. name: Major Golden Wings
descr:
**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** 2

**Access** You're from Hermea

---

This pair of huge wings is crafted from numerous feathers made of a lightweight, golden magical alloy. When activated, the wings emit a melodic sound and a shimmering glow.

## Golden Wings

**Price** 60 gp

## Greater Golden Wings

**Price** 350 gp

---

When you activate the wings, for the duration, you can also use an action to flap the wings to glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 20 feet forward through the air. As long as you spend 1 action gliding each round and haven’t yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn.

## Major Golden Wings

**Price** 650 gp

---

## True Golden Wings

**Price** 14,000 gp

---

When you activate the wings, you also gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed or 25 feet, whichever is greater, for the duration.

name: Oneiric Crystals of the Slumberer
descr:
**Price** 5,500 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

---

These trapezoidal crystals were created by a powerful alghollthu master from long-forgotten deep sea stones. They were used to steal the dreams and memories of the master’s victims, trapping them inside so they could be consulted when needed. When broken, the creatures whose memories were stolen retrieve them but are [stupefied](/condition/stupefied-player-core) 1 for 1 round.

activations.name: Steal Remembrance
activations.text:
**Frequency** once per day; **Effect** Choose a creature you can see, trapping its memories in the crystal. The creature must attempt a DC 31 Will saving throw. If the creature is asleep, it uses the outcome one degree of success worse than the result of its roll.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected and realizes you tried to steal its memories.

**Success** The creature is stupefied 1 for 1 round but doesn’t lose any memory, and believes you did something harmless to its mind.

**Failure** The creature is stupefied 2 for 1 hour and loses all memory of a particular topic that can be detailed in 50 words or fewer.

**Critical Failure** The creature is stupefied 4 for 1 day and loses all memory of two particular topics, each of which can be detailed in 50 words or fewer.

name: Sanguine Ammunition
descr:
**Price** 75 gp

**Ammunition** any

**Access** You're a member of the Red Mantis Assassins

---

This wickedly barbed ammunition looks dangerous to even touch. It dissolves into blood on impact, leaving no trace if the target has blood. The target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to saves against diseases and poisons for 1 round.

You can also Activate _sanguine ammunition_ as part of [Casting a Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core). The spell must be 3rd-rank or lower, must take 1 or 2 actions to cast, must have the [poison](/trait/poison) or [disease](/trait/disease) trait, and must target a creature other than the caster. Casting a Spell this way has no effect; instead, a creature hit by _sanguine ammunition_ activated this way is targeted by the spell in addition to the item’s normal effects. If the target isn’t a valid target for the spell, the spell is lost.

The ammunition affects only the target hit. If the spell requires a spell attack, use the result of your ranged attack roll to determine the degree of success of the spell. If the spell requires a save, the target attempts the save against your spell DC.

descr:
**Price** 2,600 gp

**Usage** worn mask

**Bulk** L

**Access** You're from the Mordant Spire

---

Carved concentric circles surround the eye and ear holes on this dark wooden mask, which lets you hear the whispers that fill the Mordant Spire. The barely audible susurrus that fills your ears advises you of peril, granting you a +1 item bonus to Perception checks for initiative and to [Seek](/action/seek-player-core), [Search](/action/search-player-core), or [Sense Motive](/action/sense-motive-player-core) against things that intend harm to you, at the GM’s discretion, such as [hostile](/condition/hostile-player-core) creatures and haunts. If you tie a foe’s initiative roll, you go first.
